name: Klar NLU
install: set -e; if ! command -v cargo-nextest >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://get.nexte.st/latest/linux | tar zxf - -C "${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin"; fi; cargo fetch --locked; (cd web && npm ci && npm run build); cargo build --locked

terminals.name: klar-server
terminals.description: Klar NLU engine: React operator UI + parse API on :10520, Wyoming intent server on :10500. Uses the built-in sample home when no HA config is mounted.
